name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: SEND-BUTTON-TRIGGER BUILD, not for production: re-targets the same id-matched "command" event technique validated by the sign-checkbox build (v0.4.18-0.4.23) onto the actual Send toolbar button and File > Send Now / Send Later menu items. A capturing listener runs before Thunderbird's own goDoCommand()/GenericSendMessage handling for that same click, so cleanup's disruptive getCerts() call is guaranteed to run before the send proceeds -- unlike compose.onBeforeSend (v0.4.19), which fires from inside Thunderbird's own send pipeline and left reading broken until restart instead of self-healing on send.
